scope: Proposition 2.2 (Amplification of the mean gradient) of the manuscript “Smooth counterexamples to Yau's nodal upper bound in dimensions three and four” (preprints/Smooth-counterexamples-to-Yaus-nodal-upper-bound-in-dimensions-three-and-four-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 350 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8e4c129bdb0f2f45), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Ω be a coordinate cube with compact closure in a smooth three-dimensional Riemannian manifold. Suppose that ϕ is smooth on a neighborhood of Ω, is strict there, and satisfies aϕ ̸= 0 there. Given T > 0 and ε > 0, there is a smooth function b ϕ on the same neighborhood such that supp(b ϕ − ϕ) ⋐ Ω, ∥b ϕ − ϕ∥C0(Ω) < ε, Z Ω |ab ϕ | dVg > T. The function b ϕ is strict and has nonvanishing gradient on Ω. More precisely, there is a constant η > 0, determined only by the fixed periodic functions chosen below, such that one finite cycle of the construction multiplies R Ω |aϕ| dVg by at least 1 + η. The cycle can have arbitrarily small C0 size. Its patch sizes and frequency thresholds may depend on the entire incoming profile and metric.
